decision.summary: A correlated multi-axis drop begins abruptly around index 495, affecting all three components (N~−2 MAD, E~−3 MAD, U~−2 MAD) over 2–3 samples. While E and U show partial recovery after ~502, N remains offset through the end of the allowed context (545), and no clear opposing return is observed. Hence, the interval 495–507 is classified as uncertain: onset and sustained interior are evident, but return is unobserved/ambiguous.

intervals.observation: N/E/U show a correlated multi-sample downward shift starting ~495 (2–3 samples), with N dropping ~2 MAD, E ~3 MAD, U ~2 MAD; recovery is partial in E and U but absent in N by index 507, and no opposing return observed within allowed context [455,545].
